terms.definition: A separate operations and evidence plane. It is never a terminal, raw SQL editor, generic MCP client, second CRM, or second IDE.
The Joe and Dell business operating application. It receives only safe Control Room request, incident, maintenance, and release summaries.
A named operational component with an owner, purpose, supported workflows, dependencies, environments, health sources, runbooks, automations, incidents, and releases.
One of local, rehearsal, staging, or production. It is explicit on every protected object and event and is never inferred from a hostname.
A read-only source result with source, target, observed time, freshness, correlation, confidence, evidence reference, and redaction classification.
The state fresh, stale, missing, or unknown. Stale or missing authoritative telemetry produces Unknown health, never Healthy.
A durable operational work envelope with origin, desired outcome, acceptance criteria, risk, target, executor, lifecycle, blockers, evidence, and release disposition.

A scoped execution envelope, not a transcript, that separately binds organization tenant, verified human sponsor or unsponsored status, acting agent principal, runtime principal, personal-brain scope and version, request, resources, environment, capability profile, expiry, phase, and evidence.
The verified Joe or Dell identity whose session originated an agent task. Sponsorship selects that partner's personal-brain scope but never replaces agent attribution or grants authority.
The registered Doc, Codex, Claude, or service actor to which an action is attributed. It is distinct from both the sponsoring human and organization tenant.
The authenticated runtime instance and credential class executing the session. It validates the agent principal and capability profile but does not choose a partner brain.

The Joe-personal or Dell-personal active rule namespace selected only from a verified sponsoring human. A missing or ambiguous expected scope is Unknown with null count, while an authenticated unsponsored agent reports scope none and zero personal and receives active shared rules and/or explicit server-attached job rules.
An immutable ordered plan with exact target, decisions, steps, risk, cost, rollback or forward fix, verification specification, and SHA-256 plan hash.
A human decision bound to one plan revision and hash, exact target and environment, re-authentication evidence, expiry, and disposition.
An immutable set of commit, configuration, schema, assets, work requests, and safe release notes.
One attempt to place one release into one explicit environment, with ordered execution events, reconnect cursor, verification runs, and rollback or forward-fix state.
A timestamped deterministic observation with source, target, outcome, freshness, failure class, and evidence.
A timestamped automation execution with registered wrapper, inputs and outputs metadata, outcome, retry, freshness, and evidence.
An operational impact record whose facts and hypotheses remain distinct and whose timeline links alerts, services, releases, requests, plans, evidence, mitigation, and recovery proof.
A narrow server-side grant binding principal, sponsor, parent request, exact resources, environment, capability, reason, issue time, expiry, and grant version.

A registered deterministic wrapper with typed inputs. Initial sanctioned families are deploy, migrate, smoke, health/probe, backup, restore, and local-agent wrappers; arbitrary command text is forbidden.
A redacted attributable result tied to an expected assertion, exact source and target, timestamp, correlation, verifier, and immutable reference.
An append-only event linking origin, actor and sponsor, request and session, scope, plan and approval, execution, verification, result, and redaction declaration.
The Workspace-safe projection of a Control Room object: opaque ID, safe label, lifecycle, plain impact or result, verified time, and next action, with no engineering internals or client payload.
The honest health state when authoritative evidence is absent, stale, out of scope, or unreachable. Unknown always names its source gap and monitoring action.

The immutable tenant and environment scope the server derives from the authenticated principal and typed server route before authorization. Client, agent, and model tenant claims are never authoritative.

Joe-controlled authority over platform code, intellectual property, provisioning, licensing, release governance, and platform-wide policy. It is distinct from and never implied by tenant administration.
Narrow owner-controlled administration within one tenant. At launch Joe administers the single CARR tenant and Dell remains a Control Room Reporter/Viewer.
The evidence-gated states experimental, pilot, approved, standard, and retired. Each work item pins an immutable version, promotion is audited, and retirement blocks new starts.

Measured normal internal human time, separately attributed exception time, toil concentration, actionable alerts, verified safe automation, and named remedies. Three complete consecutive months are required before a mature-maintenance claim.
